items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps oily, sensitive-feeling skin clean without stripping it.
A light mattifying moisturizer with a mild niacinamide level helps with shine and comfort without being heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 protects fair, easily flushed skin and is a must if you add exfoliating products later.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel because it is very strong for skin that is oily, sensitive-feeling and shows some redness, so start with this simple routine and smoother-looking texture can be revisited with a milder exfoliant once your skin is comfortable. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, and apply the SPF last every morning.
